bg:e2-ignatius-lager.desc: a hermit's forest clearing in late summer daylight, three-quarter top-down: a lean-to shelter of branches and hides against a huge old beech tree in the upper middle, a stone-ringed fire pit in the centre with two log seats, a stack of split firewood, a small clear stream along the right edge with flat stepping stones, a cleared practice ground with five tree stumps and a few hanging wooden targets on the left, a narrow path leaving at the bottom edge and one leaving at the right edge, dense forest framing the borders. Walkable open ground is earth and short grass. A standing adult would be about 1/16 of the image height, so all objects are drawn at that small scale. No people.

bg:e2-halle.desc: interior of a cold vaulted dungeon hall seen three-quarter from above: dark grey stone walls and vaults, a raised dais at the top centre with a tall high-backed black chair, a heavy rough wooden table at the left with iron straps, a lone sturdy wooden chair with an iron ring set in the floor at the right of centre, two iron braziers with ordinary orange glowing coals, an arched door at the bottom centre and a smaller iron-bound side door in the right wall, open floor of worn grey flagstones in the middle. Cold, gloomy, sparse; no banners, no mosaics, no carpet. No people, no blood. A standing adult would be about 1/8 of the image height.

bg:e2-kerker.desc: a dungeon corridor three-quarter top-down: along the top wall three small cells side by side with iron bars and barred doors, each cell with straw on the floor and an iron ring in the back wall; a stone flagstone corridor runs across the middle; a guard's small wooden table with a stool and an oil lantern at the lower left; a narrow stone stair leading up through an arched exit at the right edge; iron torch sconces with small flames on the walls. Dark grey stone, damp, gloomy, warm torchlight. No banners, no mosaics. No people, no skeletons, no blood.

bg:e2-herbsthang.desc: an autumn hillside in soft morning light: a winding earthen footpath from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner through golden and red bushes and low birch and oak trees, fallen leaves on the ground, a few grey boulders, one bush in the middle-right with a long strip of white linen cloth caught on its branches, fluttering; a glimpse of a misty valley far below at the top-left. Autumn palette of gold, rust red, ochre and soft green. No people.
bg:e2-herbsthang.note: raw promoted from e2-herbsthang-v2 (--extra: high top-down map camera, small scale, no buildings in the valley, linen snagged on the bush); see docs/rebuild/art/teil-2.json

plate:e2-pruefung.desc: Dusk in a rebel camp in a forest clearing, canvas tents and a small campfire, deep blue-violet evening sky. In the centre Lia (the slender 16-year-old girl with strawberry-blonde curls and the long moss-green cloak from the first attached reference sheet) kneels on the ground; two ordinary human rebel guards (brown padded gambesons, sleeveless tabards in dark red and white, open nasal helmets), seen mostly FROM BEHIND, stand at her sides and grip her upper arms. A sudden burst of bright TURQUOISE light erupts from Lia in a ring around her, her eyes glow bright blue-turquoise. To the left Elnon (the tall black-haired elf with a long braid and the embroidered green tunic from the second sheet) recoils a step, raising his forearm against the glare. To the right the old druid (grey braids with wooden beads, grey-green robe, leather mantle, from the third sheet) holds an EMPTY wooden bowl, startled. Full figures, nobody cut off at the head. No blood, no weapons drawn.

plate:e2-sehkugel.desc: Close-up in a dark stone chamber lit only by the object: a hand-sized clear crystal orb resting on a small black wrought-iron stand on a dark wooden table. From the top of the frame a long wide BLACK sleeve reaches in, only the pale, bony, long fingertips of a hand visible, hovering just above the orb without touching it (no face, no body, no other person). Deep inside the orb glows one TINY TURQUOISE spark. Cold violet reflections and highlights play on the crystal surface, the iron stand and the fingertips. Rough grey stone wall in deep shadow behind. Ominous, quiet mood. Anatomically correct hand: thin fingers, at most five.

plate:e2-trennung.desc: Pre-dawn in a rebel forest camp: deep blue sky just beginning to pale above the dark trees; the scene is lit warmly by a few torches on poles and one small campfire burning calmly inside a ring of stones. The camp is INTACT: plain canvas tents stand undamaged in the background. NO burning tents, NO spreading fire, no flames on anything except the torches and the campfire, no smoke clouds, no destruction, no bodies on the ground. Behind the figures runs a tall wooden palisade of sharpened upright logs. Sitting on the ground with their backs against the palisade, side by side, captive: Flick (the half-elf girl with short messy almost-black hair with one pale streak, pointed ears, olive-green hooded coat, iron shackles with a short chain on her wrists, from the second sheet) and Elnon (the elf man with long black hair in a braid and the green tunic with golden-orange leaf embroidery from the third sheet, without his axe, his wrists tied with rope). From the left, one hooded henchman of the dark army (black cloth hood pulled over his head, face in shadow, sleeveless knee-length tabard quartered in plain BLACK and WHITE over chain mail like the fifth sheet, but a black hood instead of a helmet, no emblem) drags Kyra in by the upper arm: the 16-year-old girl from the first sheet with long wavy nut-brown hair falling loose over her shoulders exactly as on that sheet, plain beige dress, wrists tied with rope; she stumbles and resists. On the right stands Baris (the HUGE bearded man in near-black plate armour with dark red straps from the fourth sheet; the RIGHT half of his face is a red mottled burn scar with a milky blind right eye), axe lowered, his head turned down, looking at the seated Flick with grim recognition. Full figures, nobody cut off at the head. No blood, no wounds.

plate:e2-bericht-xenovia.desc: A single flat sheet of pale peeled BIRCH BARK (white-cream with dark horizontal lenticel marks, curled slightly at the edges) lies on a mossy forest floor among a few fallen autumn leaves and twigs, seen from directly above, filling most of the image. On the bark a rough hand-drawn sketch in black CHARCOAL with a little brown-yellow OCHRE wash: in the middle a huge fallen goddess figure with long flowing hair, drawn in simple lines, half sinking into stylised curled WAVES; around her TEN small simple human stick-like figures with raised arms. To one side a simple drawn mountain with a cave whose mouth is sealed by a big stone, a small light glowing inside the cave. The ONLY colour in the drawing is that small cave light, coloured TURQUOISE; everything else on the bark is charcoal black and ochre. No writing, no letters, no runes on the bark.

plate:e2-bericht-wiege.desc: A single flat sheet of pale peeled BIRCH BARK (white-cream with dark horizontal lenticel marks, curled slightly at the edges) lies on a mossy forest floor among a few fallen autumn leaves and twigs, seen from directly above, filling most of the image. On the bark a rough hand-drawn sketch in black CHARCOAL with a little brown-yellow OCHRE wash: a wounded old bearded mage in a long robe WITHOUT any staff, bent and holding his side, raises one open hand over a simple wooden CRADLE in which two small swaddled infants lie side by side; behind them a simple doorway of a cottage in which a farmer man and a farmer woman stand together watching. The ONLY colour in the drawing is a small soft glow at the mage's raised hand, coloured TURQUOISE; everything else on the bark is charcoal black and ochre. No writing, no letters, no runes on the bark.

plate:e2-erinnerung.desc: A painful MEMORY image, the whole picture framed by a soft, misty COLD VIOLET vignette that fades the edges. At night, seen from a distance across a dark field: a walled medieval town on a low hill, its roofs and towers burning, orange flames and smoke rising into a dark sky, embers drifting. In the middle ground a row of kneeling prisoners in dark SILHOUETTE, heads bowed, and a few armed standing silhouettes with spears and helmets behind them, all small and featureless against the firelight. Sad, quiet, dreamlike. No gore, no blood, no execution shown, no faces.

plate:e2-schattentoeter.desc: Early morning in a hermit's camp in a forest clearing: a lean-to shelter under an old beech tree, a smoking campfire, a woodpile, mist and soft golden morning light through the trees. The old hermit Ignatius (bald crown, long untrimmed white beard, faded patched rust-orange robe under a brown forest cloak, from the first sheet) solemnly holds out with both hands a long natural wooden STAFF with knots and a leather grip wrapping. Lia (the slender 16-year-old girl with strawberry-blonde curls, moss-green cloak thrown back over her shoulders, from the second sheet) stands facing him and reaches out with one hand to take the staff. The staff is the clear focus between them. Both full figures, three-quarter view, nobody cut off at the head. No magic glow.

plate:e2-kontrolle.desc: A vaulted stone dungeon hall lit by a single iron brazier, cold shadows. Kyra (the 16-year-old girl with long nut-brown hair tied back with a cord, beige dress, from the first sheet, but WITHOUT any ropes or bonds) stands stiffly upright like a puppet, holding a plain short sword pointed downward in front of her, her face blank, a faint VIOLET sheen in her empty eyes. Before her Elnon (the tall black-haired elf with a long braid and green tunic, from the second sheet, tunic torn, bruised) kneels on the floor with iron chains on his wrists, looking up at her. Directly behind Kyra stands the tall black-hooded figure of Vamir (from the third sheet), his face COMPLETELY hidden in the black shadow of the hood, one pale bony hand resting on Kyra's shoulder, faint cold violet wisps around him. Tense and quiet. Full figures, nobody cut off at the head. No blood, no wounds shown, the sword does not touch anyone.

plate:e2-flucht.desc: A dim dungeon corridor with barred cells, a lantern on a guard table, torchlight. Flick (the half-elf with short messy almost-black hair with one pale streak, pointed ears, olive-green hunter's coat, from the first sheet, no weapons) stands in the OPEN barred door of a cell, about to slip out, looking back over her shoulder. On the stone floor at her feet lie OPENED iron manacles with a short chain. Inside the cell behind her Elnon (the tall black-haired elf with a long braid, green tunic, from the second sheet, tunic torn) sits on the floor against the barred wall, waving her to go with one hand; beside him Kyra (long nut-brown hair, beige dress, from the third sheet) lies unconscious on a bit of straw, eyes closed, peaceful. Full figures, nobody cut off at the head. No blood.

plate:e2-vamir-anhoehe.desc: A sunny grassy hilltop on a bright day, green meadow grass and a few wildflowers, a CLEAR blue sky. On the hilltop stands the tall gaunt black-hooded figure of Vamir (from the attached sheet), his face COMPLETELY hidden in the pitch-black shadow of the hood, raising both arms high with long wide sleeves; his hands are thin, long-fingered HUMAN hands with pale grey-white skin. Forked bolts of COLD VIOLET lightning crackle out from his raised hands and fork across the clear sky. Low camera from the slope, the full figure visible from hood to hem, not cut off. Background: wild rolling hills covered in dense forest, one calm lake far below, distant blue hills in haze. NO town, NO city, NO houses, NO roofs, NO towers, NO castle, NO fortress, NO ruins, NO village, NO farm, NO bridge, NO walls, NO buildings or man-made structures of any kind anywhere in the landscape, no chimney smoke: only untouched nature (forests, hills and a lake only; the lake shores are fully wooded, no clearings, no huts, no docks). Unsettling contrast of a sunny day and dark magic.

plate:e2-stadtwache.desc: Dusk, high up on a stone parapet: in the foreground the rough grey stone merlons and walkway of a battlement, nothing else built is visible. A single guard seen FROM BEHIND (no face visible) stands at the parapet: plain tabard in white and dark blue (halved, no emblem) over a chain-mail shirt, chain-mail coif under a simple round steel helmet, holding a tall spear upright. He looks out over endless rolling forested hill country that fades into blue haze far below. Far away on the horizon a single tall column of COLD VIOLET lightning rises from the hills up into the low clouds and lights them faintly violet. Orange-to-blue dusk sky. NO town, NO houses, NO roofs, NO towers, NO castle, NO village, NO buildings of any kind anywhere in the landscape, no chimney smoke: only forests and hills. Quiet, ominous mood. No writing, no banners.

plate:e2-aufbruch.desc: Golden autumn morning on a hillside path: Lia (the slender 16-year-old girl with strawberry-blonde curls tied back, moss-green cloak thrown back over her shoulders, leather satchel, from the attached sheet) walks along a narrow winding earth path through dense golden-red and orange autumn BUSHES and young birches, holding the long natural knotted wooden staff in her right hand like a walking staff. Seen from the SIDE at medium distance, her full figure visible from head to feet, walking to the right. Low warm morning sunlight, falling leaves. Background: only misty forested hills fading into soft morning haze, layer behind layer of autumn forest. NO town, NO city, NO houses, NO roofs, NO towers, NO castle, NO fortress, NO ruins, NO village, NO farm, NO bridge, NO walls, NO buildings or man-made structures of any kind anywhere in the landscape, no chimney smoke: only untouched nature (only bushes, trees, forested hills and mist). Hopeful, determined mood. No magic glow.
